items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: See I worked with him for six weeks and they got this boy Earl Watkins to take my place.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band then?

Earl had Ed Garlin, Earl Hines, and this little white trumpet player there, I can't think of his name. Muggsy was it? No, it wasn't Muggsy Spaniel, no. Another little trumpet player, he's pretty bad off sick now if he ain't dead now. He's out there in San Francisco. And we had this clarinet player, Donnell Howard. Oh man. Our clarinet. We only had a six piece lineup. Earl Hines, Donnell Howard, Ed Garlin, myself. You were on trombone. And Lil' Jimmy.
Jimmy Archie? Lil' Jimmy Archie, yeah.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: He was there last year, I heard him. Yeah, yeah, he's still with them, yeah.

ctx.x: And, well, it was six of us. Who was the trombone?
He was there last year, I heard him. Yeah, yeah, he's still with them, yeah.
